| Essential DocIO |
| ILockBytes..::..Flush Method |
| ILockBytes Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The Flush method ensures that any internal buffers maintained by the ILockBytes
implementation are written out to the underlying physical storage.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int Flush() ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function Flush As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int Flush() ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Flush() : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Flush(); ``` |

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The flush operation was successful.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - The caller does not have permission to access the byte array.
STG\_E\_MEDIUMFULL - The flush operation is not completed because there is no space
left on the storage device.
E\_FAIL - General failure writing data.
STG\_E\_TOOMANYFILESOPEN - Under certain circumstances, the Flush method executes
a download-and-closeto flush, which can lead to a return value of
STG\_E\_TOOMANYFILESOPEN if no file handles are available.
STG\_E\_INVALIDHANDLE - An underlying file has been prematurely closed, or the
correct floppy disk has been replaced by an invalid one.

#### Parameters

plkbyt
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..ILockBytes
    A pointer to the ILockBytes interface on the underlying
    byte-array object on which to create a compound file.

grfMode
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STGM
    Specifies the access mode to use when opening the new compound file.
    For more information, see STGM Constants.

reserved
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    Reserved for future use; must be zero.

ppstgOpen
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStorage%

| IStorage..::..OpenStorage Method |
| IStorage Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The OpenStorage method opens an existing storage object with the specified name in the specified access mode.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int OpenStorage( 	string pwcsName, 	IntPtr pstgPriority, 	STGM grfMode, 	IntPtr snbExclude, 	uint reserved, 	out IStorage ppstg ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function OpenStorage ( _ 	pwcsName As String, _ 	pstgPriority As IntPtr, _ 	grfMode As STGM, _ 	snbExclude As IntPtr, _ 	reserved As UInteger, _ 	<OutAttribute> ByRef ppstg As IStorage _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int OpenStorage( 	String^ pwcsName,  	IntPtr pstgPriority,  	STGM grfMode,  	IntPtr snbExclude,  	unsigned int reserved,  	[OutAttribute] IStorage^% ppstg ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OpenStorage( 	pwcsName : String,  	pstgPriority : IntPtr,  	grfMode : STGM,  	snbExclude : IntPtr,  	reserved : uint,  	ppstg : IStorage ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OpenStorage(pwcsName, pstgPriority, grfMode, snbExclude, reserved, ppstg); ``` |

#### Parameters

pwcsName
:   Type: [System..::..String](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s1wwdcbf)
    A pointer to a wide character null-terminated Unicode string that
    contains the name of the storage object to open. The 000 through 01f characters,
    serving as the first character of the stream/storage name, are reserved for use by
    OLE. This is a compound file restriction, not a structured storage restriction.
    It is ignored if pstgPriority is non-NULL.

pstgPriority
:   Type: [System..::..IntPtr](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/5he14kz8)
    Must be NULL. A non-NULL value will return STG\_E\_INVALIDPARAMETER.

grfMode
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STGM
    Specifies the access mode to use when opening the storage object.
    For descriptions of the possible values, see STGM Constants.
    Other modes you choose must at least specify STGM\_SHARE\_EXCLUSIVE when calling this method.

snbExclude
:   Type: [System..::..IntPtr](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/5he14kz8)
    Must be NULL. A non-NULL value will return STG\_E\_INVALIDPARAMETER.

reserved
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
     Reserved for future use; must be zero.

ppstg
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStorage%
    When successful, pointer to the location of an IStorage pointer to
    the opened storage object. This parameter is set to NULL if an error occurs.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The storage object was opened successfully.
E\_PENDING - Asynchronous Storage only: Part or all of the storage's data is currently unavailable.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - Not enough permissions to open storage object.
STG\_E\_FILENOTFOUND - The storage object with the specified name does not exist.
STG\_E\_INSUFFICIENTMEMORY - The storage object was not opened due to a lack of memory.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFLAG - The value specified for the grfMode parameter is not a valid STGM Constants value.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFUNCTION - The specified combination of flags in the grfMode parameter is not supported.
STG\_E\_INVALIDNAME - Not a valid value for pwcsName.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPOINTER - The pointer specified for the storage object was not valid.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPARAMETER - One of the parameters was not valid.
STG\_E\_REVERTED - The storage object has been invalidated by a revert operation above it in the transaction tree.
STG\_E\_TOOMANYOPENFILES - The storage object was not created because there are too many open files.
STG\_S\_CONVERTED - The existing stream with the specified name was replaced with a new storage
object containing a single stream called CONTENTS. In direct mode, the new storage is
immediately written to disk. In transacted mode, the new storage is written to a
temporary storage in memory and later written to disk when it is committed.

| IStream..::..Commit Method |
| IStream Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Ensures that any changes made to a stream object open in transacted mode
are reflected in the parent storage. If the stream object is open in direct
mode, IStream::Commit has no effect other than flushing all memory buffers
to the next-level storage object. The COM compound file implementation of
streams does not support opening streams in transacted mode.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

The IPropertyStorage interface manages the persistent properties of a single property set.
Persistent properties consist of information that can be stored persistently in a
property set, such as the summary information associated with a file.

The GlobalAlloc function allocates the specified number of bytes from the heap.
Windows memory management does not provide a separate local heap and global heap.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..API..::..GlobalAllocFlags
    Memory allocation attributes.

:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)

#### Return Value

If the function succeeds, the return value is a handle to the newly
allocated memory object. If the function fails, the return value is NULL.
To get extended error information, call GetLastError.

| ``` Function OpenStream ( _ 	pwcsName As String, _ 	cbReserved1 As UInteger, _ 	grfMode As STGM, _ 	reserved2 As UInteger, _ 	<OutAttribute> ByRef ppstm As IStream _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int OpenStream( 	String^ pwcsName,  	unsigned int cbReserved1,  	STGM grfMode,  	unsigned int reserved2,  	[OutAttribute] IStream^% ppstm ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OpenStream( 	pwcsName : String,  	cbReserved1 : uint,  	grfMode : STGM,  	reserved2 : uint,  	ppstm : IStream ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function OpenStream(pwcsName, cbReserved1, grfMode, reserved2, ppstm); ``` |

#### Parameters

pwcsName
:   Type: [System..::..String](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s1wwdcbf)
    A pointer to a wide character null-terminated Unicode
    string that contains the name of the stream to open. The 000 through 01f
    characters, serving as the first character of the stream/storage name, are
    reserved for use by OLE. This is a compound file restriction, not a structured
    storage restriction.

cbReserved1
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Reserved for future use; must be NULL.

grfMode
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STGM
     Specifies the access mode to be assigned to the open stream.
    For more information and descriptions of possible values, see STGM Constants.
    Other modes you choose must at least specify STGM\_SHARE\_EXCLUSIVE when calling this
    method in the compound file implementation.

reserved2
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Reserved for future use; must be zero.

ppstm
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStream%
    A pointer to IStream pointer variable that receives the
    interface pointer to the newly opened stream object. If an error occurs, \*ppstm must be set to NULL.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The stream was successfully opened.
E\_PENDING - Asynchronous Storage only: Part or all of the stream data is currently unavailable.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - Not enough permissions to open stream.
STG\_E\_FILENOTFOUND - The stream with specified name does not exist.
STG\_E\_INSUFFICIENTMEMORY - The stream was not opened due to a lack of memory.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFLAG - The value specified for the grfMode parameter is not a valid STGM Constants value.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFUNCTION - The specified combination of flags in the grfMode parameter is not supported;
for example, when this method is called without the STGM\_SHARE\_EXCLUSIVE flag.
STG\_E\_INVALIDNAME - Invalid value for pwcsName.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPOINTER - The pointer specified for the stream object was not valid.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPARAMETER - One of the parameters was not valid.
STG\_E\_REVERTED - The storage object has been invalidated by a revert operation above it in the transaction tree.
STG\_E\_TOOMANYOPENFILES - The stream was not opened because there are too many open files.

| IStream..::..Read Method |
| IStream Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream object into memory starting
at the current seek pointer.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int Read( 	byte[] pv, 	uint cb, 	ref uint pcbRead ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function Read ( _ 	pv As Byte(), _ 	cb As UInteger, _ 	ByRef pcbRead As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int Read( 	array<unsigned char>^ pv,  	unsigned int cb,  	unsigned int% pcbRead ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Read( 	pv : byte[],  	cb : uint,  	pcbRead : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Read(pv, cb, pcbRead); ``` |

#### Parameters

pv
:   Type: array<[System..::..Byte](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/yyb1w04y)>[]()[][]
    [out] Pointer to the buffer into which the stream data is read.

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    [in] Specifies the number of bytes of data to attempt to read
    from the stream object.

pcbRead
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)%
    [out] Pointer to a ULONG variable that receives the actual
    number of bytes read from the stream object. You can set this pointer to NULL to
    indicate that you are not interested in this value. In this case, this method
    does not provide the actual number of bytes read.

#### Return Value

S\_OK
Data was successfully read from the stream object.
S\_FALSE
The data could not be read from the stream object.
E\_PENDING
Asynchronous storage only: Part or all of the data to be read is currently unavailable. For more information, see IFillLockBytes and Asynchronous Storage.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED
The caller does not have enough permissions for reading this stream object.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPOINTER
One of the pointer values is not valid.
STG\_E\_REVERTED
The object has been invalidated by a revert operation above it in the transaction tree.

|  | PrintLayout | 1 | Everything that will appear in the printed document appears on the screen. |
|  | OutlineLayout | 3 | Shows the headings and subheadings in the word document. |
|  | NormalLayout | 4 | Document appears with a dotted line separating the pages and/or document sections. Columns, drawings, headers/footers, footnotes/endnotes, and comments do not appear. |
|  | WebLayout | 5 | Designed to show the word document will look as a web page. |

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Close | Saves all the data from cache and closes the stream. (Overrides [Stream..::..Close()()()()](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/4sa733cf).) |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Flush | Flushes data and resets the cache. (Overrides [Stream..::..Flush()()()()](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ke2cwez4).) |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Read | Reads data from the stream. If data is cached, the class will not call wrapped stream and will simply return a copy of cached data. (Overrides [Stream..::..Read(array<Byte>[]()[][], Int32, Int32)](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/29tb55d8).) |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | ReadByte | Reads a byte from the underlying stream. Returns an int (byte cast to an int) or -1 if it is the end of the stream. (Overrides [Stream..::..ReadByte()()()()](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/5k3tk84z).) |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Seek | On any Seek operation, data not written from cache will be flushed to the wrapped stream. Using the Position property is better as it is optimized for cache use. (Overrides [Stream..::..Seek(Int64, SeekOrigin)](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/x3d54zs7).) |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | SetLength | Sets length of wrapped stream. (Overrides [Stream..::..SetLength(Int64)](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/7c2w1ac6).) |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Write | Writes portion of data into a wrapped stream. Data will be cached if it is possible. It will then be saved to the wrapped stream on Flush. (Overrides [Stream..::..Write(array<Byte>[]()[][], Int32, Int32)](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/xsfehx6h).) |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | WriteByte | Write one byte of information into stream. (Overrides [Stream..::..WriteByte(Byte)](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/015bdtez).) |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Properties

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | BaseStream | Get reference of stream wrapped by BufferStreamEx. |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | CanRead | Indicates whether data can be read from the wrapped stream. True if data can be read. (Overrides [Stream..::..CanRead](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/0cde30tt).) |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | CanSeek | Indicates whether the wrapped stream supports Seek operations. (Overrides [Stream..::..CanSeek](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/23ke5bx8).) |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | CanWrite | Indicates whether data can be written to wrapped stream. (Overrides [Stream..::..CanWrite](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/a83yafhb).) |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Length | Gets length of the wrapped stream. When this property is accessed, the data that is not written to the stream is first flushed. (Overrides [Stream..::..Length](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s11f0b46).) |
| ![Public property](icons/pubproperty.gif "Public property") | Position | Gets the current position of stream. Position can be different from the value in wrapped stream, because wrapped stream will point to the last byte of the cached data. When this property is set, the data that is not written is flushed to the stream. (Overrides [Stream..::..Position](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/d9936z61).) |

The SetSize method changes the size of the byte array.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int SetSize( 	ulong cb ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function SetSize ( _ 	cb As ULong _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int SetSize( 	unsigned long long cb ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function SetSize( 	cb : ulong ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function SetSize(cb); ``` |

#### Parameters

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    Specifies the new size of the byte array as a number of bytes.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The size of the byte array was successfully changed.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - The caller does not have permission to access the byte array.
STG\_E\_MEDIUMFULL - The byte array size is not changed because there is no
space left on the storage device.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The STGM enumeration values are used in the IStorage, IStream, and
IPropertySetStorage interfaces. These elements are often combined
using an OR operator.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` [FlagsAttribute] public enum STGM ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` <FlagsAttribute> _ Public Enumeration STGM ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` [FlagsAttribute] public enum class STGM ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public enum STGM ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGM = function(); Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGM.createEnum('Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGM', true); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Members

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | STGM\_READ | 0 | Indicates that the object is read-only, meaning that modifications cannot be made. |
|  | STGM\_WRITE | 1 | STGM\_WRITE lets you save changes to the object, but does not permit access to its data. |
|  | STGM\_READWRITE | 2 | STGM\_READWRITE allows you to both access and modify an object's data. |
|  | STGM\_SHARE\_DENY\_NONE | 64 | Specifies that subsequent openings of the object are not denied read or write access. If no flag from the sharing group is specified, this flag is assumed. |
|  | STGM\_SHARE\_DENY\_READ | 48 | Prevents others from subsequently opening the object in STGM\_READ mode. It is typically used on a root storage object. |
|  | STGM\_SHARE\_DENY\_WRITE | 32 | Prevents others from subsequently opening the object for STGM\_WRITE or STGM\_READWRITE access. |
|  | STGM\_SHARE\_EXCLUSIVE | 16 | Prevents others from subsequently opening the object in any mode. In transacted mode, sharing of STGM\_SHARE\_DENY\_WRITE or STGM\_SHARE\_EXCLUSIVE can significantly improve performance since they don't require snapshotting. |
|  | STGM\_PRIORITY | 262144 | Opens the storage object with exclusive access to the most recently committed version. |
|  | STGM\_CREATE | 4096 | Indicates that an existing storage object or stream should be removed before the new one replaces it. |
|  | STGM\_CONVERT | 131072 | Creates the new object while preserving existing data in a stream named "Contents". |
|  | STGM\_FAILIFTHERE | 0 | Causes the create operation to fail if an existing object with the specified name exists. |
|  | STGM\_DIRECT | 0 | In direct mode, each change to a storage or stream element is written as it occurs. |
|  | STGM\_TRANSACTED | 65536 | In transacted mode, changes are buffered and written only if an explicit commit operation is called. |
|  | STGM\_NOSCRATCH | 1048576 | In transacted mode, a temporary scratch file is usually used to save modifications until the Commit method is called. |
|  | STGM\_NOSNAPSHOT | 2097152 | This flag is used when opening a storage object with STGM\_TRANSACTED and without STGM\_SHARE\_EXCLUSIVE or STGM\_SHARE\_DENY\_WRITE. |
|  | STGM\_SIMPLE | 134217728 | STGM\_SIMPLE is a mode that provides a much faster implementation of a compound file in a limited, but frequently used case. |
|  | STGM\_DIRECT\_SWMR | 4194304 | The STGM\_DIRECT\_SWMR supports direct mode for single-writer, multireader file operations. |
|  | STGM\_DELETEONRELEASE | 67108864 | Indicates that the underlying file is to be automatically destroyed when the root storage object is released. |

| Visual Basic |

| ``` unsigned int SetData( 	FORMATETC% pformatetc,  	STGMEDIUM% pmedium,  	int fRelease ) ``` |

| ``` function SetData(pformatetc, pmedium, fRelease); ``` |

#### Parameters

pformatetc
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..FORMATETC%
    Pointer to the FORMATETC structure defining the format used by the data object
    when interpreting the data contained in the storage medium.

pmedium
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STGMEDIUM%
    Pointer to the STGMEDIUM structure defining the storage medium in which the
    data is being passed.

fRelease
:   Type: [System..::..Int32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/td2s409d)
    If TRUE, the data object called, which implements IDataObject::SetData, owns
    the storage medium after the call returns. This means it must free the medium after it has been used
    by calling the ReleaseStgMedium function.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - Data was successfully transferred.
Otherwise error code.

| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | CreateStorage | The CreateStorage method creates and opens a new storage object nested within this storage object with the specified name in the specified access mode. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | CreateStream | The CreateStream method creates and opens a stream object with the specified name contained in this storage object. All elements within a storage objects, both streams and other storage objects, are kept in the same name space. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | DestroyElement | The DestroyElement method removes the specified storage or stream from this storage object. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | EnumElements | The EnumElements method retrieves a pointer to an enumerator object that can be used to enumerate the storage and stream objects contained within this storage object. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | MoveElementTo | The MoveElementTo method copies or moves a substorage or stream from this storage object to another storage object. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | OpenStorage | The OpenStorage method opens an existing storage object with the specified name in the specified access mode. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | OpenStream | The OpenStream method opens an existing stream object within this storage object in the specified access mode. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | RenameElement | The RenameElement method renames the specified substorage or stream in this storage object. |

| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | SetElementTimes | The SetElementTimes method sets the modification, access, and creation times of the specified storage element, if the underlying file system supports this method. |

|  |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The SetStateBits method stores up to 32 bits of state information in this storage object.
This method is reserved for future use.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int SetStateBits( 	uint grfStateBits, 	uint grfMask ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function SetStateBits ( _ 	grfStateBits As UInteger, _ 	grfMask As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int SetStateBits( 	unsigned int grfStateBits,  	unsigned int grfMask ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function SetStateBits( 	grfStateBits : uint,  	grfMask : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function SetStateBits(grfStateBits, grfMask); ``` |

#### Parameters

grfStateBits
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Specifies the new values of the bits to set. No legal values are
    defined for these bits; they are all reserved for future use and must not be used by applications.

grfMask
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    A binary mask indicating which bits in grfStateBits are significant in this call.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The state information was successfully set.
Otherwise error code.

On any Seek operation, data not written from cache will be
flushed to the wrapped stream. Using the Position property is better as
it is optimized for cache use.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public override long Seek( 	long offset, 	SeekOrigin origin ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Overrides Function Seek ( _ 	offset As Long, _ 	origin As SeekOrigin _ ) As Long ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: virtual long long Seek( 	long long offset,  	SeekOrigin origin ) override ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public override function Seek( 	offset : long,  	origin : SeekOrigin ) : long ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Seek(offset, origin); ``` |

#### Parameters

offset
:   Type: [System..::..Int64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/6yy583ek)
    New offset of stream.

origin
:   Type: [System.IO..::..SeekOrigin](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/883dhyx0)
    Start point of seek operation.

#### Return Value

Current position.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Perspective Style
This is just a 2D transformation matrix (3x3). Specifying peculiar values will cause
the shape to render completely outside its geometry - normally clients will constrain
the values to get reasonable results. The transformation may be applied at various
times as the geometry is processed, this affects the behavior of the perspective
which results in the same way as the corresponding shadow perspective types.

The STGC enumeration constants specify the conditions for performing
the commit operation in the IStorage::Commit and IStream::Commit methods.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` [FlagsAttribute] public enum STGC ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` <FlagsAttribute> _ Public Enumeration STGC ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` [FlagsAttribute] public enum class STGC ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public enum STGC ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGC = function(); Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGC.createEnum('Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGC', true); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Members

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | STGC\_DEFAULT | 0 | You can specify this condition with STGC\_CONSOLIDATE or some combination of the other three flags in this list of elements. |
|  | STGC\_OVERWRITE | 1 | The commit operation can overwrite existing data to reduce overall space requirements. |
|  | STGC\_ONLYIFCURRENT | 2 | Prevents multiple users of a storage object from overwriting each other's changes. |
|  | STGC\_DANGEROUSLYCOMMITMERELYTODISKCACHE | 4 | Commits the changes to a write-behind disk cache, but does not save the cache to the disk. |
|  | STGC\_CONSOLIDATE | 8 | Microsoft Windows 2000/XP: Indicates that a storage should be consolidated after it is committed, resulting in a smaller file on disk. |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Methods

|  | Name | Description |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Clone | Creates a new stream object that references the same bytes as the original stream but provides a separate seek pointer to those bytes. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Commit | Ensures that any changes made to a stream object open in transacted mode are reflected in the parent storage. If the stream object is open in direct mode, IStream::Commit has no effect other than flushing all memory buffers to the next-level storage object. The COM compound file implementation of streams does not support opening streams in transacted mode. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | CopyTo | Copies a specified number of bytes from the current seek pointer in the stream to the current seek pointer in another stream. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | LockRegion | Restricts access to a specified range of bytes in the stream. Supporting this functionality is optional since some file systems do not provide it. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Read | Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream object into memory starting at the current seek pointer. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Revert | Discards all changes that have been made to a transacted stream since the last call to IStream::Commit. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Seek | Changes the seek pointer to a new location relative to the beginning of the stream, the end of the stream, or the current seek pointer. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | SetSize | Changes the size of the stream object. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Stat | Retrieves the STATSTG structure for this stream. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | UnlockRegion | Removes the access restriction on a range of bytes previously restricted with IStream::LockRegion. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Write | Writes a specified number of bytes into the stream object starting at the current seek pointer. |

|  | Enumeration | Description |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTE3dObject | 3D Object Material properties of a 3D object. A 3D effect overrides the fill and line effects and corresponding colors. Extrusion depths are always specified in absolute units. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTE3dStyle | 3D Style Properties of a 3D view; note that distances are in drawing units. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEBlip | How a BLIP fits into a shape. This includes cropping information as well as picture display modifications such as brightness and contrast. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEBottomLineStyle |  |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTECallout | Callout Properties of a callout shape. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEFillStyle | Two main colors are defined - a foreground color and a background color. Different fillTypes use these values differently. In addition to the foreground and background any number of shade colors can be defined. Each shade color is associated with a "position" which says how far into the shade the color appears – colors must be given in position order. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEGeometry | The geometry of the shape. Typically, these properties reside in a shape type definition, and so are not written to the file. However, freeform shapes drawing using the polygon tools set the pVertices and pSegmentInfo properties to define their geometries. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEGeoText | Effect text of the shape - this is what the WordArt tools use, and is separate from the attached text present in ordinary textboxes. Theoretically, a shape could have both (a WordArt with attached text), but this is not currently allowed by the UI. Note that font information is provided here. The default text size is in points, the text effect geometry interfaces require the device size of a point to interpret this. The default point size is a 16.16 fixed-point number. A text effect is present if the fGText boolean is set and either the gtextUNICODE (UNICODE) or gtextRTF (RTF) is present, the UNICODE string takes precedence, however it cannot include any additional font information (unlike the RTF). |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEGroupShape | Group Shape Miscellaneous shape properties that can apply to group shapes. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTELeftLineStyle |  |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTELineStyle | Lines are centered about the infinitely thin proto-line along which they are drawn. Complex dash effects are supported only for simple lines (e.g. changing the end cap) - defaults should be used for other line styles. The line width is in EMUs; a line width of zero should not be used - there is no logical interpretation on a high-resolution printer. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEPerspectiveStyle | Perspective Style This is just a 2D transformation matrix (3x3). Specifying peculiar values will cause the shape to render completely outside its geometry - normally clients will constrain the values to get reasonable results. The transformation may be applied at various times as the geometry is processed, this affects the behavior of the perspective which results in the same way as the corresponding shadow perspective types. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEProtection | Changes the behavior of a shape by restricting direct manipulation. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTERightLineStyle |  |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEShadowStyle | The interpretation of the transform properties depends on the type of shadow: msoshadowOffset, msoshadowDouble: Only the offset is used. It is interpreted as an absolute offset expressed in EMUs. The default corresponds to 1/36" in both X and Y (2 or 3 pixels on screen depending on monitor resolution). The offset is relative to the drawing axes (as msoshadowDrawing below, not msoshadowRich) so a shadow offset to the bottom right of the drawing is still offset (by the same amount) to the bottom right if the shape is rotated. The "double" case causes two shadows to be drawn, the first (lower) at the second offset and in the shadowHighlightColor. If the second offset is 0,0 it defaults to being the inverse of the first. msoshadowRich: The offsets and transformation properties are in absolute units measured relative to the shape on the drawing - the shadow moves with the shape, but anisotropic scaling of the shape changes the proportions of the shadow, not its angles. Compare with the following where such scaling scales the shadow in proportion too, thus changes the angle between (e.g.) a vertical line in the shape and it's shadow. msoshadowShape: The offsets and transformation properties are relative to the shape; 1.0 corresponds to the shape width/height as appropriate. The shadow is cast relative to the shape then scaled with the shape, so it moves with the shape. The units are simple numbers (ratios of the G unit space effectively). This transformation type is unnatural in real world terms, but behaves nicely in geometric terms. The offset elements of the property set are treated as fixed-point 16.16 values. msoshadowDrawing: A rich shadow cast onto a plane in drawing space. The transform is applied to the drawing coordinates of the shape and is thus expressed in EMUs. This shadow type enables creation of shadows from multiple objects, however the shadows may overlap higher (different) objects if the shadow plane and shape drawing planes overlap on the screen. The shadowWeight parameter is used as in the perspective property set to apply addiitonal scaling to the perspective parameters - these are divided by the weight. Shadow transformations are independent of the perspective transformation applied to a shape - either hte perspective transformation or the shadow transformation is used as appropriate. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEShape | Shape Miscellaneous properties of a single shape which do not apply to group shapes. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTEText | How text fits in a shape. Text is host-dependent, so some hosts may ignore some of these properties. |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTETopLineStyle |  |
| ![Public enumeration](icons/pubenumeration.gif "Public enumeration") | FOPTETransform |  |

|  |

| Essential DocIO |
| ILockBytes..::..ReadAt Method |
| ILockBytes Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The ReadAt method reads a specified number of bytes
starting at a specified offset from the beginning of the byte array object.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int ReadAt( 	ulong ulOffset, 	byte[] pv, 	uint cb, 	out uint pcbRead ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function ReadAt ( _ 	ulOffset As ULong, _ 	pv As Byte(), _ 	cb As UInteger, _ 	<OutAttribute> ByRef pcbRead As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int ReadAt( 	unsigned long long ulOffset,  	array<unsigned char>^ pv,  	unsigned int cb,  	[OutAttribute] unsigned int% pcbRead ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function ReadAt( 	ulOffset : ulong,  	pv : byte[],  	cb : uint,  	pcbRead : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function ReadAt(ulOffset, pv, cb, pcbRead); ``` |

#### Parameters

ulOffset
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    Specifies the starting point from the beginning
    of the byte array for reading data.

pv
:   Type: array<[System..::..Byte](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/yyb1w04y)>[]()[][]
    Pointer to the buffer into which the byte array is read.
    The size of this buffer is contained in cb.

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Specifies the number of bytes of data to attempt to read
    from the byte array.

pcbRead
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)%
    Pointer to a ULONG where this method writes the actual
    number of bytes read from the byte array. You can set this pointer to NULL
    to indicate that you are not interested in this value. In this case, this
    method does not provide the actual number of bytes that were read.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - Indicates that the specified number of bytes were read, or the
maximum number of bytes were read to the end of the byte array.
E\_FAIL - Data could not be read from the byte array.
E\_PENDING - Asynchronous Storage only: Part or all of the data to be
read is currently unavailable.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - The caller does not have permission to access the byte array.
STG\_E\_READFAULT - The number of bytes to be read does not equal the number of bytes
that were actually read

The MoveElementTo method copies or moves a substorage or stream from this storage
object to another storage object.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int MoveElementTo( 	string pwcsName, 	IStorage pstgDest, 	string pwcsNewName, 	uint grfFlags ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function MoveElementTo ( _ 	pwcsName As String, _ 	pstgDest As IStorage, _ 	pwcsNewName As String, _ 	grfFlags As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int MoveElementTo( 	String^ pwcsName,  	IStorage^ pstgDest,  	String^ pwcsNewName,  	unsigned int grfFlags ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function MoveElementTo( 	pwcsName : String,  	pstgDest : IStorage,  	pwcsNewName : String,  	grfFlags : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function MoveElementTo(pwcsName, pstgDest, pwcsNewName, grfFlags); ``` |

#### Parameters

pwcsName
:   Type: [System..::..String](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s1wwdcbf)
    Pointer to a wide character null-terminated Unicode string
    that contains the name of the element in this storage object to be moved or copied.

pstgDest
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStorage
     IStorage pointer to the destination storage object.

pwcsNewName
:   Type: [System..::..String](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s1wwdcbf)
    Pointer to a wide character null-terminated unicode string
    that contains the new name for the element in its new storage object.

grfFlags
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Specifies whether the operation should be a move (STGMOVE\_MOVE)
    or a copy (STGMOVE\_COPY). See the STGMOVE enumeration.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The storage object was successfully copied or moved.
Otherwise error code.

if supported by the implementation. Not all implementations support all these time values.

| Visual C++ |

| --- |
| ``` function SetTimes( 	pctime : FILETIME,  	patime : FILETIME,  	pmtime : FILETIME ) ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function SetTimes(pctime, patime, pmtime); ``` |

#### Parameters

pctime
:   Type: [System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes..::..FILETIME](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/sebaea1s)%
    Pointer to the new creation time for the property set. May be NULL,
    indicating that this time is not to be modified by this call.

patime
:   Type: [System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes..::..FILETIME](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/sebaea1s)%
    Pointer to the new access time for the property set. May be NULL,
    indicating that this time is not to be modified by this call.

pmtime
:   Type: [System.Runtime.InteropServices.ComTypes..::..FILETIME](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/sebaea1s)%
    Pointer to the new modification time for the property set. May be
    NULL, indicating that this time is not to be modified by this call.

| ILockBytes..::..LockRegion Method |

|  |

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The LockRegion method restricts access to a specified range of bytes in the byte array.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int LockRegion( 	ulong libOffset, 	ulong cb, 	uint dwLockType ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function LockRegion ( _ 	libOffset As ULong, _ 	cb As ULong, _ 	dwLockType As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int LockRegion( 	unsigned long long libOffset,  	unsigned long long cb,  	unsigned int dwLockType ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function LockRegion( 	libOffset : ulong,  	cb : ulong,  	dwLockType : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function LockRegion(libOffset, cb, dwLockType); ``` |

#### Parameters

libOffset
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    Specifies the byte offset for the beginning of the range.

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    Specifies, in bytes, the length of the range to be restricted.

dwLockType
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Specifies the type of restrictions being requested on
    accessing the range. This parameter uses one of the values from the LOCKTYPE enumeration.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The specified range of bytes was locked
STG\_E\_INVALIDFUNCTION - Locking is not supported at all or the specific type of lock
requested is not supported.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - Access denied because the caller has insufficient permission,
or another caller has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_LOCKVIOLATION - Access denied because another caller has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_INVALIDHANDLE - An underlying file has been prematurely closed, or the
correct floppy disk has been replaced by an invalid one

| IStorage..::..CopyTo Method |
| IStorage Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The CopyTo method copies the entire contents of an open storage object to another storage object.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int CopyTo( 	uint ciidExclude, 	IntPtr rgiidExclude, 	IntPtr snbExclude, 	IStorage pstgDest ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function CopyTo ( _ 	ciidExclude As UInteger, _ 	rgiidExclude As IntPtr, _ 	snbExclude As IntPtr, _ 	pstgDest As IStorage _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int CopyTo( 	unsigned int ciidExclude,  	IntPtr rgiidExclude,  	IntPtr snbExclude,  	IStorage^ pstgDest ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function CopyTo( 	ciidExclude : uint,  	rgiidExclude : IntPtr,  	snbExclude : IntPtr,  	pstgDest : IStorage ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function CopyTo(ciidExclude, rgiidExclude, snbExclude, pstgDest); ``` |

#### Parameters

ciidExclude
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    The number of elements in the array pointed to by rgiidExclude.
    If rgiidExclude is NULL, then ciidExclude is ignored.

rgiidExclude
:   Type: [System..::..IntPtr](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/5he14kz8)
    An array of interface identifiers (IIDs) that either the caller
    knows about and does not want copied or that the storage object does not support but whose
    state the caller will later explicitly copy.

snbExclude
:   Type: [System..::..IntPtr](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/5he14kz8)
    A string name block (refer to SNB) that specifies a block of storage
    or stream objects that are not to be copied to the destination. These elements are not created
    at the destination. If IID\_IStorage is in the rgiidExclude array, this parameter is ignored.
    This parameter may be NULL.

pstgDest
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStorage
    Pointer to the open storage object into which this storage object is to be copied.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The storage object was successfully copied.
E\_PENDING - Asynchronous Storage only: Part or all of the data to be copied is currently unavailable.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - The destination storage object is a child of the source storage object.
STG\_E\_INSUFFICIENTMEMORY - The copy was not completed due to a lack of memory.
Otherwise - Error code.

## File: html/6ae808bb-3ef5-b6e6-b128-d6895a895907.htm

![Collapse image](icons/collapse_all.gif "Collapse image")![Expand Image](icons/expand_all.gif "Expand Image")![](icons/collapse_all.gif)![](icons/expand_all.gif)![](icons/dropdown.gif)![](icons/dropdownHover.gif)![Copy image](icons/copycode.gif "Copy image")![CopyHover image](icons/copycodeHighlight.gif "CopyHover image")

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/collapse_all.gif) Collapse AllExpand All     ![](icons/dropdown.gif) Code: All Code: Multiple Code: C# Code: Visual Basic Code: Visual C++ Code: JScript Code: JavaScript Code: XAML Code: ASP.NET |

C#
Visual Basic
Visual C++
JScript
JavaScript
XAML
ASP.NET

|  |
| --- |
| Essential DocIO |
| API..::..StgOpenStorage Method |
| API Class [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

StgOpenStorage opens an existing root storage object in the file system. You
can use this function to open compound files but you cannot use it to open
directories, files, or summary catalogs. Nested storage objects can only be
opened using their parents' IStorage::OpenStorage method.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static int StgOpenStorage( 	string wcsName, 	IntPtr stgPriority, 	STGM grfMode, 	IntPtr snbExclude, 	uint reserved, 	out IStorage storage ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function StgOpenStorage ( _ 	wcsName As String, _ 	stgPriority As IntPtr, _ 	grfMode As STGM, _ 	snbExclude As IntPtr, _ 	reserved As UInteger, _ 	<OutAttribute> ByRef storage As IStorage _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static int StgOpenStorage( 	String^ wcsName,  	IntPtr stgPriority,  	STGM grfMode,  	IntPtr snbExclude,  	unsigned int reserved,  	[OutAttribute] IStorage^% storage ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function StgOpenStorage( 	wcsName : String,  	stgPriority : IntPtr,  	grfMode : STGM,  	snbExclude : IntPtr,  	reserved : uint,  	storage : IStorage ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.API.StgOpenStorage = function(wcsName, stgPriority, grfMode, snbExclude, reserved, storage); ``` |

#### Parameters

wcsName
:   Type: [System..::..String](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s1wwdcbf)
    [in] Pointer to the path of the NULL-terminated
    Unicode string file containing the storage object to open. This parameter
    is ignored if the pstgPriority parameter is not NULL.

stgPriority
:   Type: [System..::..IntPtr](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/5he14kz8)
    Most often NULL. If not NULL, this parameter is
    used instead of the pwcsName parameter to specify the pointer to the
    IStorage interface on the storage object to open. It points to a previous
    opening of a root storage object, most often one that was opened in priority
    mode. After the StgOpenStorage function returns, the storage object specified
    in the pstgPriority parameter on function entry is not valid and can no
    longer be used. Instead, use the storage object specified in the ppStgOpen
    parameter.

grfMode
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STGM
    Specifies the access mode to use to open the
    storage object.

snbExclude
:   Type: [System..::..IntPtr](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/5he14kz8)
    If not NULL, pointer to a block of elements in
    the storage that are to be excluded as the storage object is opened. The
    exclusion occurs regardless of whether a snapshot copy happens on the open.
    May be NULL.

reserved
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Indicates reserved for future use; must be zero.

storage
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStorage%
    [out] Pointer IStorage\* pointer variable that receives
    the interface pointer to the opened storage.

#### Return Value

S\_OK
Indicates that the storage object was successfully opened.
STG\_E\_FILENOTFOUND
Indicates that the specified file does not exist.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED
Access denied because the caller does not have enough permissions, or another caller
has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_LOCKVIOLATION
Access denied because another caller has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_SHAREVIOLATION
Access denied because another caller has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_FILEALREADYEXISTS
Indicates that the file exists but is not a storage object.
STG\_E\_TOOMANYOPENFILES
Indicates that the storage object was not opened because there are too many open files.
STG\_E\_INSUFFICIENTMEMORY
Indicates that the storage object was not opened due to inadequate memory.
STG\_E\_INVALIDNAME
Indicates a non-valid name in the pwcsName parameter.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPOINTER
Indicates a non-valid pointer in one of the parameters: snbExclude, pwcsName,
pstgPriority, or ppStgOpen.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFLAG
Indicates a non-valid flag combination in the grfMode parameter.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFUNCTION
Indicates STGM\_DELETEONRELEASE specified in the grfMode parameter.
STG\_E\_OLDFORMAT
Indicates that the storage object being opened was created by the Beta 1 storage
provider. This format is no longer supported.
STG\_E\_NOTSIMPLEFORMAT
Indicates that the STGM\_SIMPLE flag was specified in the grfMode parameter and the
storage object being opened was not written in simple mode.
STG\_E\_OLDDLL
The DLL being used to open this storage object is a version of the DLL that is older
than the one used to create it.
STG\_E\_PATHNOTFOUND
Specified path does not exist.
STG\_E\_SHAREVIOLATION
Access denied because another caller has the file open and locked.

| ILockBytes..::..UnlockRegion Method |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The UnlockRegion method removes the access restriction on a previously
locked range of bytes.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int UnlockRegion( 	ulong libOffset, 	ulong cb, 	uint dwLockType ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function UnlockRegion ( _ 	libOffset As ULong, _ 	cb As ULong, _ 	dwLockType As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int UnlockRegion( 	unsigned long long libOffset,  	unsigned long long cb,  	unsigned int dwLockType ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function UnlockRegion( 	libOffset : ulong,  	cb : ulong,  	dwLockType : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function UnlockRegion(libOffset, cb, dwLockType); ``` |

#### Parameters

libOffset
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    Specifies the byte offset for the beginning of the range.

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    Specifies, in bytes, the length of the range that is restricted.

dwLockType
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Specifies the type of access restrictions previously
    placed on the range. This parameter uses a value from the LOCKTYPE enumeration.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The byte range was unlocked.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFUNCTION - Locking is not supported at all or the specific type
of lock requested is not supported.
STG\_E\_LOCKVIOLATION The requested unlock cannot be granted.

| STGFMT Enumeration |
| [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The STGFMT enumeration values specify the format of a storage object
and are used in the StgCreateStorageEx and StgOpenStorageEx functions
in the STGFMT parameter.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public enum STGFMT ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Enumeration STGFMT ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public enum class STGFMT ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public enum STGFMT ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGFMT = function(); Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGFMT.createEnum('Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STGFMT', false); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Members

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | STGFMT\_STORAGE | 0 | Indicates that the file must be a compound file. |
|  | STGFMT\_FILE | 3 | Indicates that the file must not be a compound file. |
|  | STGFMT\_ANY | 4 | Indicates that the system will determine the file type and use the appropriate structured storage or property set implementation. |
|  | STGFMT\_DOCFILE | 5 | Indicates that the file must be a compound file and is similar to the STGFMT\_STORAGE flag, but indicates that the compound-file form of the compound-file implementation must be used. |

| Essential DocIO |
| ILockBytes..::..WriteAt Method |
| ILockBytes Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The WriteAt method writes the specified number of bytes starting at a specified offset
from the beginning of the byte array.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int WriteAt( 	ulong ulOffset, 	byte[] pv, 	uint cb, 	out uint pcbWritten ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function WriteAt ( _ 	ulOffset As ULong, _ 	pv As Byte(), _ 	cb As UInteger, _ 	<OutAttribute> ByRef pcbWritten As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int WriteAt( 	unsigned long long ulOffset,  	array<unsigned char>^ pv,  	unsigned int cb,  	[OutAttribute] unsigned int% pcbWritten ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function WriteAt( 	ulOffset : ulong,  	pv : byte[],  	cb : uint,  	pcbWritten : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function WriteAt(ulOffset, pv, cb, pcbWritten); ``` |

#### Parameters

ulOffset
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    Specifies the starting point from
    the beginning of the byte array for the data to be written.

pv
:   Type: array<[System..::..Byte](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/yyb1w04y)>[]()[][]
    Pointer to the buffer containing the data to be written.

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Specifies the number of bytes of data to attempt to write into
    the byte array.

pcbWritten
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)%
    Pointer to a location where this method specifies the
    actual number of bytes written to the byte array. You can set this pointer to
    NULL to indicate that you are not interested in this value. In this case, this
    method does not provide the actual number of bytes written.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - Indicates that the specified number of bytes were written.
E\_FAIL - A general failure occurred during the write operation.
E\_PENDING - Asynchronous Storage only: Part or all of the data to be
written is currently unavailable.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - The caller does not have enough permissions for writing
this byte array.
STG\_E\_WRITEFAULT - The number of bytes to be written does not equal the number
of bytes that were actually written.
STG\_E\_MEDIUMFULL - The write operation was not completed because there is no
space left on the storage device. The actual number of bytes written is still
returned in pcbWritten.

#### Parameters

cpspec
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    The numerical count of properties to be deleted. The value of this parameter can
    legally be set to zero, however that defeats the purpose of the method as no properties are thereby
    deleted, regardless of the value set in rgpspec.

rgpspec
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..PROPSPEC%
    Properties to be deleted. A mixture of property identifiers and string-named
    properties is permitted. There may be duplicates, and there is no requirement that properties be
    specified in any order.

| IComDataObject..::..GetDataHere Method |
| IComDataObject Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Called by a data consumer to obtain data from a source data object. This method differs
from the GetData method in that the caller must allocate and free the specified storage medium.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` uint GetDataHere( 	ref FORMATETC pformatetc, 	ref STGMEDIUM pRemoteMedium ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function GetDataHere ( _ 	ByRef pformatetc As FORMATETC, _ 	ByRef pRemoteMedium As STGMEDIUM _ ) As UInteger ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` unsigned int GetDataHere( 	FORMATETC% pformatetc,  	STGMEDIUM% pRemoteMedium ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function GetDataHere( 	pformatetc : FORMATETC,  	pRemoteMedium : STGMEDIUM ) : uint ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function GetDataHere(pformatetc, pRemoteMedium); ``` |

#### Parameters

pformatetc
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..FORMATETC%
    Pointer to the FORMATETC structure that defines the format, medium, and target
    device to use when passing the data.

pRemoteMedium
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STGMEDIUM%
    Pointer to the STGMEDIUM structure that defines the storage medium
    containing the data being transferred.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - Data was successfully retrieved and placed in the storage medium provided.
Otherwise error code.

| ILockBytes..::..Stat Method |
| ILockBytes Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The Stat method retrieves a STATSTG structure containing information for
this byte array object.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int Stat( 	out STATSTG pstatstg, 	uint grfStatFlag ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function Stat ( _ 	<OutAttribute> ByRef pstatstg As STATSTG, _ 	grfStatFlag As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int Stat( 	[OutAttribute] STATSTG% pstatstg,  	unsigned int grfStatFlag ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Stat( 	pstatstg : STATSTG,  	grfStatFlag : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Stat(pstatstg, grfStatFlag); ``` |

#### Parameters

pstatstg
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STATSTG%
    Pointer to a STATSTG structure in which this method
    places information about this byte array object. The pointer is NULL if
    an error occurs.

grfStatFlag
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    Specifies whether this method should supply the
    pwcsName member of the STATSTG structure through values taken from the
    STATFLAG enumeration. If the STATFLAG\_NONAME is specified, the pwcsName
    member of STATSTG is not supplied, thus saving a memory-allocation operation.
    The other possible value, STATFLAG\_DEFAULT, indicates that all members of the
    STATSTG structure be supplied.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - The STATSTG structure was successfully returned at
the specified location.
E\_OUTOFMEMORY - The STATSTG structure was not returned due to a lack of memory
for the name member in the structure.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - The STATSTG structure was not returned because the caller
did not have access to the byte array.
STG\_E\_INSUFFICIENTMEMORY - The STATSTG structure was not returned, due to
insufficient memory.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFLAG - The value for the grfStateFlag parameter is not valid.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPOINTER - The value for the pStatStg parameter is not valid.

| [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

The STREAM\_SEEK enumeration values specify the origin from which to
calculate the new seek-pointer location.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public enum STREAM_SEEK ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Enumeration STREAM_SEEK ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public enum class STREAM_SEEK ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public enum STREAM_SEEK ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STREAM_SEEK = function(); Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STREAM_SEEK.createEnum('Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.STREAM_SEEK', false); ``` |

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Members

|  | Member name | Value | Description |
|  | STREAM\_SEEK\_SET | 0 | The new seek pointer is an offset relative to the beginning of the stream. In this case, the dlibMove parameter is the new seek position relative to the beginning of the stream. |
|  | STREAM\_SEEK\_CUR | 1 | The new seek pointer is an offset relative to the current seek pointer location. In this case, the dlibMove parameter is the signed displacement from the current seek position. |
|  | STREAM\_SEEK\_END | 2 | The new seek pointer is an offset relative to the end of the stream. In this case, the dlibMove parameter is the new seek position relative to the end of the stream. |

:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STATSTG%

Two main colors are defined - a foreground color and a background color.
Different fillTypes use these values differently. In addition to the foreground
and background any number of shade colors can be defined. Each shade color
is associated with a "position" which says how far into the shade the color appears
– colors must be given in position order.

| Essential DocIO |
| IStream..::..Write Method |
| IStream Interface [See Also](#seeAlsoToggle) Send Feedback |

|  |
| --- |
| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Writes a specified number of bytes into the stream object starting at the
current seek pointer.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int Write( 	byte[] pv, 	uint cb, 	ref uint pcbWritten ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function Write ( _ 	pv As Byte(), _ 	cb As UInteger, _ 	ByRef pcbWritten As UInteger _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int Write( 	array<unsigned char>^ pv,  	unsigned int cb,  	unsigned int% pcbWritten ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Write( 	pv : byte[],  	cb : uint,  	pcbWritten : uint ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function Write(pv, cb, pcbWritten); ``` |

#### Parameters

pv
:   Type: array<[System..::..Byte](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/yyb1w04y)>[]()[][]
    [in] Pointer to the buffer containing the data that is to be
    written to the stream. A valid pointer must be provided for this parameter even
    when cb is zero.

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    [in] The number of bytes of data to attempt to write into the
    stream. Can be zero.

pcbWritten
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)%
    [out] Pointer to a ULONG variable where this method
    writes the actual number of bytes written to the stream object. The caller can
    set this pointer to NULL, in which case this method does not provide the actual
    number of bytes written.

#### Return Value

S\_OK
The data was successfully written to the stream object.
E\_PENDING
Asynchronous Storage only: Part or all of the data to be written is currently
unavailable. For more information, see IFillLockBytes and Asynchronous Storage.
STG\_E\_MEDIUMFULL
The write operation was not completed because there is no space left on the storage
device.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED
The caller does not have enough permissions for writing to this stream object.
STG\_E\_CANTSAVE
Data cannot be written for reasons other than improper access or insufficient space.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPOINTER
One of the pointer values is not valid. The pv parameter must contain a valid pointer
even if cb is zero.
STG\_E\_REVERTED
The object has been invalidated by a revert operation above it in the transaction tree.
STG\_E\_WRITEFAULT
The write operation was not completed due to a disk error. This value is also returned
when this method attempts to write to a stream that was opened in simple mode (using
the STGM\_SIMPLE flag).

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Copies a specified number of bytes from the current seek pointer in the stream to
the current seek pointer in another stream.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` int CopyTo( 	IStream pstm, 	ulong cb, 	ref ulong pcbRead, 	ref ulong pcbWritten ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Function CopyTo ( _ 	pstm As IStream, _ 	cb As ULong, _ 	ByRef pcbRead As ULong, _ 	ByRef pcbWritten As ULong _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` int CopyTo( 	IStream^ pstm,  	unsigned long long cb,  	unsigned long long% pcbRead,  	unsigned long long% pcbWritten ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` function CopyTo( 	pstm : IStream,  	cb : ulong,  	pcbRead : ulong,  	pcbWritten : ulong ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` function CopyTo(pstm, cb, pcbRead, pcbWritten); ``` |

#### Parameters

pstm
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStream
    [in] Pointer to the destination stream. The stream pointed to
    by pstm can be a new stream or a clone of the source stream.

cb
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)
    [in] Specifies the number of bytes to copy from the source
    stream.

pcbRead
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)%
    [out] Pointer to the location where this method writes the
    actual number of bytes read from the source. You can set this pointer to NULL to
    indicate that you are not interested in this value. In this case, this method
    does not provide the actual number of bytes read.

pcbWritten
:   Type: [System..::..UInt64](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/06cf7918)%
    [out] Pointer to the location where this method writes
    the actual number of bytes written to the destination. You can set this pointer
    to NULL to indicate that you are not interested in this value. In this case,
    this method does not provide the actual number of bytes written.

| ![](icons/gradient.gif) |

Lines are centered about the infinitely thin proto-line along which they are drawn.
Complex dash effects are supported only for simple lines (e.g. changing the end cap) -
defaults should be used for other line styles. The line width is in EMUs; a line width
of zero should not be used - there is no logical interpretation on a high-resolution printer.

| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Clone | The Clone method creates a new enumerator that contains the same enumeration state as the current STATSTG structure enumerator. Using this method, a client can record a particular point in the enumeration sequence and then return to that point at a later time. The new enumerator supports the same IEnumSTATSTG interface. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Next | The Next method retrieves a specified number of STATSTG structures, that follow subsequently in the enumeration sequence. If there are fewer than the requested number of STATSTG structures left in the enumeration sequence, it retrieves the remaining STATSTG structures. |
| ![Public method](icons/pubmethod.gif "Public method") | Reset | The Reset method resets the enumeration sequence to the beginning of the STATSTG structure array. |

StgCreateDocfile creates a new compound file storage object using the COM-provided
compound file implementation for the IStorage interface.

**Namespace:** Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native
**Assembly:** Syncfusion.DocIO.Base (in Syncfusion.DocIO.Base.dll) Version: 11.104.0.21

# ![](icons/collapse_all.gif)Syntax

| C# |
| --- |
| ``` public static int StgCreateDocfile( 	string pwcsName, 	STGM grfMode, 	uint reserved, 	out IStorage ppstgOpen ) ``` |

| Visual Basic |
| --- |
| ``` Public Shared Function StgCreateDocfile ( _ 	pwcsName As String, _ 	grfMode As STGM, _ 	reserved As UInteger, _ 	<OutAttribute> ByRef ppstgOpen As IStorage _ ) As Integer ``` |

| Visual C++ |
| --- |
| ``` public: static int StgCreateDocfile( 	String^ pwcsName,  	STGM grfMode,  	unsigned int reserved,  	[OutAttribute] IStorage^% ppstgOpen ) ``` |

| JScript |
| --- |
| ``` public static function StgCreateDocfile( 	pwcsName : String,  	grfMode : STGM,  	reserved : uint,  	ppstgOpen : IStorage ) : int ``` |

| JavaScript |
| --- |
| ``` Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native.API.StgCreateDocfile = function(pwcsName, grfMode, reserved, ppstgOpen); ``` |

#### Parameters

pwcsName
:   Type: [System..::..String](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/s1wwdcbf)
    [in] Pointer to a NULL-terminated Unicode string name for the
    compound file being created. It is passed uninterpreted to the file system. This can
    be a relative name or NULL. If NULL, a temporary compound file is allocated with a
    unique name.

grfMode
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..STGM
    [in] Specifies the access mode to use when opening the new
    storage object. For more information, see the STGM enumeration. If the caller
    specifies transacted mode together with STGM\_CREATE or STGM\_CONVERT, the overwrite
    or conversion takes place when the commit operation is called for the root storage.
    If IStorage::Commit is not called for the root storage object, previous contents of
    the file will be restored. STGM\_CREATE and STGM\_CONVERT cannot be combined with
    the STGM\_NOSNAPSHOT flag, because a snapshot copy is required when a file is
    overwritten or converted in the transacted mode.

reserved
:   Type: [System..::..UInt32](http://msdn2.microsoft.com/en-us/library/ctys3981)
    [in] Reserved for future use; must be zero.

ppstgOpen
:   Type: Syncfusion.CompoundFile.DocIO.Native..::..IStorage%
    [out] Pointer to the location of the IStorage pointer to
    the new storage object.

#### Return Value

S\_OK - Indicates that the compound file was successfully created.
STG\_E\_ACCESSDENIED - Access denied because the caller does not have enough permissions
or another caller has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_FILEALREADYEXISTS
Indicates that the compound file already exists and grfMode is set to STGM\_FAILIFTHERE.
STG\_E\_INSUFFICIENTMEMORY
Indicates that the compound file was not created due to inadequate memory.
STG\_E\_INVALIDFLAG
Indicates a non-valid flag combination in the grfMode parameter.
STG\_E\_INVALIDNAME
Indicates a non-valid name in the pwcsName parameter.
STG\_E\_INVALIDPOINTER
Indicates a non-valid pointer in the pwcsName parameter or the ppStgOpen parameter.
STG\_E\_LOCKVIOLATION
Access denied because another caller has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_SHAREVIOLATION
Access denied because another caller has the file open and locked.
STG\_E\_TOOMANYOPENFILES
Indicates that the compound file was not created due to a lack of file handles.
STG\_S\_CONVERTED
Indicates that the specified file was successfully converted to storage format.
